verdict.summary: The change narrowly authorizes repository-label creation only when the paginated PR-files payload witnesses an added, copied, or renamed crate-root Cargo.toml; names are constrained before use, incomplete or otherwise unresolved change sets remain fail-closed, dry-run remains non-mutating, and creation failures propagate except for a live-set-verified concurrent-create race. The implementation also keeps the known-label set current during backfills. Tests exercise the real planning and effect paths, including creation/application ordering, idempotence, concurrency, truncation, non-witness cases, permanent-write permission scope, and explicit POST parameters. No correctness, soundness, security, or vacuity issue requiring changes was found.
